name: NoRisk Client
description: NoRisk Client is a custom Minecraft Client with over 2k daily active users. It provides an extensive set of features e.g. securely hosting singleplayer worlds publicly via a custom proxy, play minigames like tetris against other players and useful in-game HUD overlays.

name: GalaxyBot
description: GalaxyBot is a Discord Bot with over 3M users centered around support systems, moderation & advanced team management.

name: auth-rs
description: auth-rs is a custom from scratch OIDC compatible identity provider written in Rust. It supports custom roles, scopes, external Apps (OIDC), 2FA, webauthen passkeys and generic user based json data storage for OAuth Applications.

name: Local Media Listener
description:
A kotlin library that provides a simple way to subscibe to media changes on any device, by loading custom dlls that access the OS level media APIs.

Supports Windows (AMD), Linux (ARM and AMD) and MacOS (ARM and AMD).

name: Spotify Overlay
description: A Minecraft mod that provides a in-game overlay of your current playing Song. It supports any App that can play music on your PC, since it gets the information from the Local Media Listener library.

name: Rustcord
description:
A cross-platform Discord Desktop App written from scratch in Rust and Svelte using Tauri.

Work in Progress

name: SmartHome
description: A custom SmartHome backend and frontend that supports Ikea Tradfri and Shelly devices and syncs device states to every open App in real-time.

name: ProjectHub
description:
A cross-platform project management desktop app with features similar to Jira and Trello. It supports realtime data sync over multiple independent instances without a server.
Archived school project from 12th grade.

name: RCON-Web
description: A WebApp that allows you to manage your Minecraft Server via the RCON protocol. It supports multiple servers and provides basic but useful features like player management and console access.

name: OAuth System
description:
A custom OAuth system that supports custom roles, scopes, external Apps, permissions and 2FA for my own personal projects.

This is archived and will now replaced by auth-rs.

name: Framework
description:
A custom "Web-Framework" written in Go that makes it easy to write dynamic html templates, map them to stylesheets and scripts and render them either server-side or client-side.
This was just a fun challenge but I still use it in some of my older projects.
